abi_notes: Signature includes implicit self for instance functions and final const MethodInfo*; displayed parameters are declared parameters only
Function prefix bytes are exact file bytes and not a license to assume instruction span/patch width
set_TargetFrameRate body has8bytes, prefer safe direct call from main-thread Update rather than an unverified long entry overwrite
RenderingData/CameraData metadata offsets include16-byte boxed header; use explicitly recorded unboxed offsets for native ref struct pointers, and verify caller actual ABI
Unity Camera get_rect/set_rect use Rect value HFA ABI on arm64 (four float components); injected variants use pointer to Rect. Use exact compiler ABI, not generic void* casts.
Exact original Il2CppType layout uses byref bit29, pinned bit30, valuetype bit31; managed parameter types with & are emitted as pointers to value/ref storage in native ABI
Validate actual object class as UnityEngine.RenderTexture or subclass before invoking direct concrete override; do not invoke Texture base getters as a substitute.
Vector3 layout is x,y,z float32; Quaternion layout is x,y,z,w float32. Injected APIs write to the passed output pointer.
Optional local rotation getter is included because equal rect dimensions/localPosition/localScale alone do not rule out a rotated image and clipping.
Injected instance void methods pass self as x0, address of Vector2/Vector3 as x1 and optional IL2CPP MethodInfo as x2.
Vector2 is two float32 values (8 bytes); Vector3 is three float32 values (12 bytes).
get_sizeDelta_Injected writes its output (parameter attributes Out=2); setters receive byref input.
get_isActiveAndEnabled is an instance bool getter: self as x0, MethodInfo as x1.
The original Cinemachine physical branch calls Camera.set_focalLength after Update and bypasses set_fieldOfView; compare actual perspective matrix edge rays instead of raw fieldOfView alone.
scope_guards: Only expanded photo scene active, VLSRPTargetImage type Target=0, current texture matches main target
Require original applyAspectRatio=true for first implementation unless retaining/restoring full fitter and layout state
Acquire parent via Transform.get_parent; verify it is a live RectTransform before calling get_rect_Injected
Do not claim fullviewport until actual texture dimensions and image/parent/window aspect are measured compatible; otherwise waiting_for_scene
lifecycle: Exact OnDestroy tail-calls ResetCameraRender in both classes; see lifecycle_proof.
Store weak GC handles for camera/image/parent and validate UnityEngine.Object liveness on Unity thread before dereferencing; exact C API export proof is separate
Changing applyAspectRatio false->true may AddComponent/enable AspectRatioFitter and mutate layout, so flag-only restoration is insufficient

current_target_singleton_proof.meaning: All use the same generic singleton accessor with the exact same method-info global slot. GetCurrentTarget Target=0 obtains this singleton targetTexture+0x98 then op_Implicit; Captured=1 obtains its capturedTexture+0xa0. No arbitrary per-image controller field.

texture_dimension_dispatch: Original UpdateTexture uses virtual texture.width/height. Prefer verified RenderTexture.get_width/get_height for an object validated as RenderTexture, or use virtual dispatch; base Texture API alone is not proof of concrete dispatch.
